fields.title: 📖 Tawakkul like the birds
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“If you were to rely upon Allah as is due to Him, He would provide for you as He provides for the birds: they leave in the morning hungry and return in the evening full.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** True **Tawakkul** does not mean inactivity, but ***trust in Allah together with permitted effort***. The birds do not stay sitting — they go out, and their **Rizq** comes from Allah.

immutable.source: 📝 at-Tirmidhī, al-Jāmiʿ, Kitāb az-Zuhd, Hadith Nr. 2344; Ibn Mājah Nr. 4164; Aḥmad Nr. 205; überliefert von ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb.
